scope: Appendix E Revit QA / Review Checklists and related QA/QC workflow coverage

sources.title: Revit Style Guide - QA / Review Checklists
sources.notes: The draft source is intentionally style-focused. Round 006 creates the machine-readable check/evidence layer without converting style QA into technical coordination or acceptance authority.

sources.title: Workflow & Instruction Catalogue Overview
sources.notes: W7.2 already exists as the higher-level QA/QC validation workflow. Round 006 supplies a Revit preflight evidence package that W7.2 can consume; the workflow remains separate from contractual/client acceptance authority.

explicit_non_promotions: Source example print scales are not enterprise thresholds.
Placeholder owners/reviewers are not promoted into role authority.
No warning-count, purge, file-size, sync-frequency, open-time, or other model-health threshold is invented without an approved source/configuration.
The QA checklist does not become coordination sign-off or contractual acceptance authority.
